sn24.45:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kim upādāya kim abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati Na vātā vāyanti na najjo sandanti na gabbhiniyo vijāyanti || na candimasūriyā udenti vā apenti vā esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhitā || || Bhagavammūlakā no bhante dhammā || pe ||
sn24.45:2.1: Rūpe kho bhikkhave sati rūpam upādāya rūpam abhinivissa evam diṭṭhi uppajjati Na vātā vāyanti || pe || || esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhitā || || Vedanāya sati || Saññāya sati || Saṅkhāresu sati || Viññāṇe sati viññāṇam upādāya viññāṇam upādāya viññāṇam abhinivissa evam diṭṭhi uppajjati || Na vātā vāyanti || pe || esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhitā ti
